_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: By the roadside a blind man hears the crowd.
Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!
They told him to be quiet; he cried out the more.
Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!
What do you want me to do? Teacher, let me see again.
Your faith has made you well.
Come, let us worship and follow on the way.
We see, and we follow. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Beside the Jericho road sat Bartimaeus, blind and begging, and when he heard that it was Jesus he began to shout.
Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on us.
They hushed him, but he only cried louder, until Jesus stopped and said, Call him here. Take heart; he is calling you.
Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on us.
He threw off his cloak and came. What do you want? Teacher, let me see. And at once the light came back.
Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on us.
See, God is bringing the people home, the blind among them, by a level road and streams of water. Come, let us follow and worship.
Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on us. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A blind man called out from the roadside.
Lord, let us see.
They told him to hush; he cried out louder.
Lord, let us see.
What do you want? Teacher, let me see again.
Lord, let us see.
His sight returned, and he followed on the way.
We see, and we follow. Amen.
